description: The stock arm of the H10 vague-goal pair: one Claude Code session with nothing installed gets the same vague goal and the same repository, a real model.
why: Program H10, a vague goal: the request says only 'Finance needs an export of expenses'; the eight constraints that decide whether finance can use it (entry points, inclusive range and order, semicolon delimiter, amount format, columns, cost centre, soft deletes, file naming) are scattered through the seed's docs/, not in the requirement text. An implementer that investigates and plans before coding should find them; one that codes from the request should miss some. No human answers questions in either arm, so everything is discoverable in the repository. Judged by a check neither arm can see (harness/scripts/check-vague-export.cjs). Run both arms together with --repeat N and an approved --max-usd.

pair.goal: Finance needs an export of expenses. Implement phase 1 of .planning/roadmap.md.

steps.prompt: Finance needs an export of expenses. Implement phase 1 of .planning/roadmap.md. Do not ask questions.
steps.why: The session finishes. Where the export lives is the docs' business, so the hidden check judges it.
The project's own tests and the new ones pass.
Every constraint the docs set holds, judged by a check neither arm saw.
